title: Shard Thermals
tagline: Compare load-shedding strategies as request pressure grows.

curves.label: Exponential Backoff
curves.code: let score=8; let k=1; while(k< n/10){score += 2.2*Math.pow(k/10,1.35); k*=1.6;} return score;
curves.name: Exponential Backoff

curves.label: Power-of-Two Choices
curves.code: let score=6; let m=n; for(let t=0;t<3;t++){m = Math.max(1, m - (1<<t)); score += 9*Math.log2(m+1)/3;} return score;
curves.name: Power-of-Two Choices

curves.label: Consistent Hash with Smoothing
curves.code: let score=10; let L=Math.log2(n+1); score += 1.8*L*L + 0.02*n; return score;
curves.name: Consistent Hash with Smoothing

curves.label: Queue Collapse Spiral
curves.code: let score=4; let q=n; for(let i=0;i<5;i++){q*= (1 + 0.01*i); score += 0.001*q*q;} return score;
curves.name: Queue Collapse Spiral
